objective: For G_77={0,1,...,76}^2, determine D(77), the largest cardinality of a subset containing no three distinct collinear points, or improve either side of the current certified interval 152 <= D(77) <= 154.
terminalCondition: The root program is complete only when validity-v4 accepted evidence establishes the exact value of D(77), with a rigorously verified construction or lower-bound certificate and a matching rigorous upper bound. A strict improvement to only one side of the interval advances the objective but is not terminal unless the certified bounds coincide.

workUnit.definition: One focused person-hour of research by a researcher qualified for the relevant work package, using the fixed conventional tool baseline named by this contract.
workUnit.toolBaseline: Public mathematical literature and standard non-autonomous research tools available as of 2026-09-01, including handwritten reasoning, exact integer arithmetic, symbolic algebra, reproducible numerical computation, SAT or CP-SAT software, proof assistants, and code execution on commodity research hardware; autonomous LLM or agent labor and unpublished solution-specific information are excluded.

referenceCommunity.description: A counterfactual community of competent human mathematical researchers collaborating on the canonical No-Three-in-Line objective at n=77, with its program portfolio defined exclusively by the bound publication-forbidden V10 shadow knowledge projection.
referenceCommunity.researcherQualification: For each local work package, a researcher with graduate-level mathematical maturity and the combinatorics, discrete geometry, exact computation, constraint programming, or proof expertise needed to begin productive work without general disciplinary training, but without unpublished solution-specific knowledge.
